translation_review.raw_machine_translation: Process for Recognition of a registrar already exists in another country that corresponds to the request of AIM of a product jt registered in another country, in which Mozambique has as its reference or have specific bilateral agreements in this area: they must submit a valid IMA; d) Collaborative process corresponding to the request of AIM of a product whose quality, safety and effectiveness has been or will be evaluated by a regional or international entity in which Mozambique is a member. * 2. For the first subparagraph of point (d), the applicant shall express the interest in ANARME and the regional or international entity. 3. The documentation to be submitted to ANARME in the context of the collaborative process shall be identical to that submitted to the regional or international entity by paying the due fee. 4.  Without prejudice to the previous paragraph, Module 1 provided for in Article 17(a) shall comply with the recommendations of ANARME. 5, The reference countries for the procedure referred to in paragraph (c) of this Article shall be: countries of the European Union, the United States of America, Brazil, the United Kingdom and the Member States of the Southern African Development Community (SADC), as well as other countries with which the Republic of Mozambique will enter into agreements to this end.
